profile.name: Kaushal Kalas
profile.title: AI/ML Developer
profile.tagline: I build machine-learning systems that solve real problems, and I like understanding how they work under the hood.
about: I am an AI/ML-focused developer currently pursuing my engineering degree, where I spend most of my time turning ideas into working models — from natural-language systems to computer-vision experiments.
I care about the full lifecycle of a project: framing the problem, cleaning the data, training the model, and shipping something people can actually use.

Right now I am learning deep learning at scale and exploring how LLMs can be grounded in real, verifiable data. Long term, I want to build intelligent systems that are useful, honest, and well-engineered.
I enjoy hackathons, open-source collaboration, and the messy middle of any technical problem — the part where it stops being a tutorial and starts being real.
profile.learning: Deep learning at scale, LLM grounding and retrieval, and production ML tooling.

projects.name: DocSage — RAG-powered document assistant
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented question-answering system that answers questions strictly from a user's own documents, with citations and no hallucinated answers.
projects.problem: Generic chatbots invent answers when asked about private or niche documents; teams needed a system that could only answer from their own material.

projects.name: CampusPlanner — smart timetable scheduler
projects.description: A constraint-based scheduler that generates conflict-free college timetables, saving departments hours of manual arrangement each semester.
projects.problem: Department staff spent days hand-fitting rooms, faculty, and batches into a timetable; small changes cascaded into large conflicts.

projects.name: SignNet — sign language recognition
projects.description: A computer-vision model that recognizes common ISL hand gestures in real time, built as a hackathon prototype and improved over two months.
projects.problem: Hearing people rarely know sign language; a lightweight real-time recognizer could bridge everyday communication.

projects.name: PriceScope — ML price forecaster
projects.description: A time-series experiment forecasting product prices using gradient-boosted trees, with honest error reporting and feature analysis.
projects.problem: Small sellers price by guesswork; even a modestly accurate forecast with uncertainty bands is more useful than intuition.

responsibilities: Built data pipelines for a text-classification research project
Ran and compared baseline models against SOTA approaches
Documented experiments for the team's reproducibility report
experience.outcomes: Cut experiment turnaround by ~30% with a reusable evaluation harness.

responsibilities: Contributed bug fixes and documentation to ML libraries
Reviewed community PRs and triaged issues
experience.outcomes: Merged contributions across multiple repositories; maintainer of two small experiment repos.
